criteria.contract: Add the integration-proposal and adopted-backlog scope that the first reassessment missed (plots, work types, abilities, life events, clan units, appointments, public order, auto-stop, marriage alliance, screen issues, sound) to the affected existing items without changing the 60 items or weights.
Re-rate only the affected items downward in proportion to the added scope; record old and new percentages, the added scope and the reason for each item.
Record the total change as an excluded reassessment, never as earned implementation progress; no code, tests or assets change.
Re-freeze the next implementation stage (NPC purpose) on the second re-rated baseline before its code exists, keeping its per-item target increments.
Regenerate the progress view and pass the existing progress and approval-batch checks.
